supersedes.note: v1 keeps its bytes; it is superseded on its FIGURES, not on its substance

why_a_revision: v1's headline figures were wrong in both directions and are corrected here. v1 derived each attempt id from the preserver index's execution_id, which is NULL for the 17 pre-execution-id executions, so 17 entries collapsed to a single empty-string id: it reported 49 distinct attempts (48 real plus '') and 48 invisible to the census. ezek_controlling_rulings_a1#e11 caught this, refused to install the candidate manifest built on it, and ordered the manifest rebuilt with a blank id failing the build. Rebuilding it with the STABLE attempt id - the execution_id's prefix where one exists, the index's map_key only where it does not - gives the real figures below.
class: a consumer reads a route its producer stopped writing; a coverage number measured on an empty route
severity: high on counterfactual blast radius; zero shipped impact - caught by the required dry run before the pre_primaries statement was written and before any final-check slice plan was built
how_it_was_found: the Q8 pre_primaries DRY RUN (#e4 ruling (10) requires a dry run before the real build) printed census Ezek transcript_retained 5 against a record stating all Ezekiel map transcripts are preserved. The two were compared by route rather than reconciled by prose.

what_the_census_reads.rule: SP.rglob of transcript_manifest.v*.json; retention = entry bytes > 0

what_v1_said_and_why_it_was_wrong.the_error: attempt ids derived from execution_id, which is null for 17 executions, so they became one blank id
what_v1_said_and_why_it_was_wrong.direction: v1 UNDERSTATED how much evidence exists, so the corrected picture is better, not worse
what_v1_said_and_why_it_was_wrong.who_caught_it: ezek_controlling_rulings_a1#e11, from its own read of the candidate manifest against the index

a_second_correction_in_the_cure.what: #e11's own Q1 text says 'attempt_id = the index's map_key'. Taken literally that is wrong for 15 entries whose map_key is a per-transcript key (ezek_controlling_rulings_a1_wave2 for execution ezek_controlling_rulings_a1#e2, and so on): it yields 78 distinct attempt ids against 66 receipt attempts.
a_second_correction_in_the_cure.why_it_matters: it would inflate retention in exactly the way the SAME ruling's intersection rule exists to prevent, and contradict its own statement that the figure is 'neither the empty route's 5 nor the blank-counting 49'
a_second_correction_in_the_cure.what_was_done: the stable attempt id was used, the deviation recorded in the manifest as a ruling_text_discrepancy, and it is routed to S5
a_second_correction_in_the_cure.class: E-03-i, as ledger E-03-i-e10-S3-03 recorded an order's exact_spans misstating its ruled item rows
